title: email: POST /api/v1/email/send still answers 500 EMAIL_SEND_FAILED when a recipient's display name is not a string — the rejection row's writer calls name.trim() after the 400 was already raised
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZtZMhQkARKJtViA9U

Filing gate: ① a product defect, a QA run clause fail (integration-system.email-template-render acceptance[7]), reach: the public send door, measured on 2 fresh boots.
Business reason: the send door's contract is that a caller who writes a bad recipient gets a 400 naming the field, so an integration or an admin script can fix its input; a 500 says "the server broke" and sends the operator to the logs. #29152 fixed this for malformed address strings (PR #29250), and its summary says the non-string display name case was covered too, but that case still answers 500. Without the fix the 18.3.0 send door keeps one 500 for a caller error.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then a `domain:server` implementer in `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts` (one guard plus a test that reaches the rejection-record path). QA suggestion only: p2.
Duplicate search (incl. closed): `email send display name 500` → 48 hits, `EMAIL_SEND_FAILED` → 3 hits. Nearest: #29152 (closed by #29250, the string-address half); none covers a non-string name.

## Reproduction (subject `589049b0`, stock showcase boot)
1. Sign in as admin (bearer).
2. `POST /api/v1/email/send` `{"to":{"address":"ok@example.com","name":42},"subject":"x","text":"x"}`.

Expected: 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` "invalid recipient address in `to`: the display name of ok@example.com must be a string". Actual: 500 `{"code":"EMAIL_SEND_FAILED","error":"a.name?.trim is not a function"}`; server log `[REST] Email send unhandled error: TypeError: a.name?.trim is not a function at rawAddressText … EmailService.recordRejectedMessage`. Same 500 for `cc` `{address,name:42}`, `replyTo` `{address,name:true}` and a `to` list entry `{address,name:{x:1}}`; a string name answers 200. Reproduced on 2 fresh boots, 3 runs; dist equals source.

## Mechanism
`rawAddressText()` (`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts` ~L409–419) calls `a.name?.trim()` on the caller's raw value while writing the rejection row in `recordRejectedMessage`, after `normalizeMessage` / `formatCallerAddress` (~L319–335) already threw the right `VALIDATION_FAILED`. `email-service.test.ts` covers `normalizeMessage` only and `email-send-door-bounds.test.ts` runs over a mail double, so no test reaches the rejection-record path.

QA-source: #29890 · integration-system.email-template-render · acceptance[7]
